# Annals of Palliative Medicine

> A peer-reviewed medical journal dedicated to advancing palliative care and end-of-life medicine through rigorous research and clinical excellence.

Annals of Palliative Medicine is a comprehensive open-access journal published by AME Groups that covers palliative care, symptom management, and quality-of-life research. The journal adheres to international standards including ICMJE and COPE guidelines, with a transparent peer-review process and strong emphasis on publication ethics.

## Key Topics

- Palliative medicine
- Palliative care
- Cancer treatment
- Publication ethics
- Peer review process
- Medical journal
- Editorial policy
- ICMJE standards
- COPE guidelines
- Manuscript evaluation
- Double-blind review
- Research ethics
- Scoping review
- Brain tumors
- Clinical research

- [Guidelines for Authors - Annals of Palliative Medicine](https://apm.amegroups.org/pages/view/guidelines-for-authors): Manuscript submission requirements and author instructions

- [Reference Style - Annals of Palliative Medicine](https://apm.amegroups.org/page/about/reference-style): Vancouver reference style citation format guidelines
- [Submit Multimedia Files - Annals of Palliative Medicine](https://apm.amegroups.org/pages/view/submit-multimedia-files): Guidelines for submitting videos and multimedia content

## Ethics & Editorial Policies

- [Publication Ethics Policy - Annals of Palliative Medicine](https://apm.amegroups.org/page/about/publication-ethics-policy): Publication ethics, authorship, and research integrity standards
- [Research Ethics Policy - Annals of Palliative Medicine](https://apm.amegroups.org/page/about/research-ethics-policy): Research ethics requirements including Declaration of Helsinki

- [Editorial Policies - Annals of Palliative Medicine](https://apm.amegroups.org/page/about/editorial-policies): Editorial standards and ICMJE/COPE compliance policies
